text:
toni: Quick sync: we're flipping v2 header-negotiation on for /generate and /chat routes. Planning a short-form rollout during the weekday quiet window (02:00-06:00 UTC). Need pin/handback plan.

jules: thumbs up. What's the customer pin policy?

mina: Propose: auto-pin tenants that report mobile-sdk=false? Wait, that won't work. Better: pinned_by_tag = ["mobile-legacy", "thirdparty-proxy"]. Manual handback by CS within 2h.

toni: Good. Also add a soft-signal: if >10 tenant pins within first hour, pause rollout automatically.

devops-bot: note: autoscaling config patch required for header-neg path (PR #4142). Will link once merged.

deploy-bot: preflight started: v2-header-negation-cutover -> checks: schema-compat, client-sig, ingress-proxy. Run `/deploybot preflight v2-header-negation --env=prod` to validate.

jules: Rollback triggers proposed: - tenant_pin_rate >= 10 in 1h -> pause - error_rate_delta >= 1% -> rollback - client_auth_failures increase by 0.3% -> rollback

mina: Ops snippet to pause/rollback: ```
/rollout pause v2_header_neg
/rollout set v2_header_neg 0% --reason="rollback: auth-failure"
```

ops-oncall: I'll be paged if any rollback happens. Which channel for rapid comms? #release-handoff or #incidents?

toni: Use #release-handoff for quick ops chatter and #incidents for pages. We'll put a pinned message with handback steps.

deploy-bot: preflight passed on staging at 2026-04-02T01:05Z. Scheduling cutover: 2026-04-05T03:00Z UTC. Canary-bot will post progress.

jules: Release notes item: "v2 header negotiation: better client header casing tolerance and content-type negotiation. Breaking change: older SDKs (<1.3.2) may need header normalization." Add migration snippet and CS template.

mina: CS template: include tenant id, pinned_until, reason, and toggle link. I'll add to the pin doc.

toni: Final checklist: PR merged (devops-bot), preflight green (deploy-bot), pinlist prepared (mina), notes & CS template (jules). I'll trigger schedule if all green.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: v2-header-negation-cutover-2026-04-05T03:00Z. Will post status every 10m during ramp. Good luck! :rocket:
